But do you actually have what it takes to run with the big dogs? Let's find out. How about you and me teamup and do a couple of runs, a little competition, see who can stack the most. You in?

You the man!... Neah, you are right, I am the man. But you did good rookie. Listen, from now on - give me a shout when you wanna teamup and let these tourists know what's what. The boys are still sketchy about you, but you and I will make them love you!
